en-US.description: Aigoni is a blog and a Wiki knowledge base that grows together with AI.
en-US.longDescription: Aigoni combines a blog and an LLM Wiki knowledge base in one local Markdown file system. It supports personal notes, web clipping, an LLM Wiki, blog publishing, brand sites, enterprise knowledge bases, and automated SEO sites. It has no database dependency and stores everything in local files; both the blog front end and the admin console support customizable UIs, and a full REST API is available.

zh-CN.description: Aigoni 是博客，也是你和 AI 共同成长的 Wiki 知识库。
zh-CN.longDescription: Aigoni 把「博客」和「LLM Wiki 知识库」放在一个本地 Markdown 文件系统里，支持个人笔记、网页收藏、LLM Wiki、博客展示、品牌官网、企业知识库与自动化 SEO 站点。它无数据库依赖，仅使用本地文件储存；博客前台和后台管理均支持自定义切换前端 UI 界面，并提供完整的 REST API。
zh-CN.name: Aigoni
